description: This header file declares the interface for the CCSP Message Bus Service, including function prototypes for engaging the message bus, initializing, finalizing, checking, freeing resources, sending signals, and handling message callbacks in the CCSP environment.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages the message bus for a specific component, configuration, and path.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message bus interface with provided user data.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up resources for the message bus interface.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Performs a health check of the message bus.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources based on priority and user data.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_SendParameterValueChangeSignal
methods.description: Sends a signal indicating a parameter value has changed.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_SendTransferCompleteSignal
methods.description: Sends a signal indicating transfer completion.

methods.name: CcspPandM_path_message_func
methods.description: Handles incoming DBus messages on a specified path.

methods.name: ssp_PnmMbi_RegisterToCR
methods.description: Registers the component to the control repository with parameter array.
